optimized_sql:
SELECT dt.d_year, fi.brand_id, fi.brand, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
JOIN store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id AS brand_id, i_brand AS brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
) fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY dt.d_year, fi.brand, fi.brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, fi.brand_id
LIMIT 100
